### Why dancers choose Milano Sensual Congress

A focused Bachata congress in Milan with the practical details international dancers care about: the venue, the teaching language, the artists and the full weekend experience.

#### Executive congress venue

Devero Hotel hosts the workshops, socials, parties and official hotel booking under one roof, making the weekend easier to plan.

#### International artist lineup

Learn from established Bachata artists from across Europe, with workshops built for technique, musicality, connection and social dancing.

#### English-friendly workshops

The congress is designed for international dancers, with English-friendly teaching and communication throughout the main program.

#### Organized for dancers

Created by dancers who understand what makes a congress flow: clear tickets, real support, smart logistics and more time for the dance floor.

#### Dancer-led experience

The weekend is shaped around what dancers actually need: quality floors, useful workshops, comfortable timing, friendly socials and memorable parties.

#### More than one Bachata style

Although the name says Sensual, the program embraces Dominican style, Esencia style, Sensual style, Bachazouk and other modern Bachata influences.

#### Frequently Asked Questions

##### Can I change the name on my ticket?

Yes, name changes are possible. You can perform this action directly on the website for a small administrative fee. Please manage your booking through the ticket platform.

##### What do I need to participate in the Jack & Jill?

To participate in the competition, you must hold a valid **Full Pass** or a **Full Party Pass**. The competition fee is separate (20 CHF), but it requires one of these passes to be valid.

##### Can I buy the Masterclass separately?

No. The Masterclass is an upgrade, which means you **must have a valid Full Pass** first. If you purchase the upgrade without a Full Pass, your entry to the masterclass will not be valid.

##### Where is the event located?

The event takes place entirely at the **Devero Hotel** in Cavenago di Brianza. This 4-star exclusive venue hosts all workshops, day socials, and night parties under one roof.
